decisions.title: Ben: Kenneth Walker III
decisions.recommendation: Offer Jaxson Dart; Parker Washington; Harold Fannin Jr.; 2029 round 1 (Jordan) for Kenneth Walker III. opening: add 2027 round 2 + 2027 round 2 (Max's) -> you +24, him +5; target: add 2029 round 1 -> you +13, him +15; walk-away: add 2028 round 1 (Max's) -> you +6, him +23
decisions.value: you +13 (this season +23, later -10), him +15; your 1st place 56% -> 63%, title 39% -> 43%
decisions.reason: Payout $ (P18). 'This season' adds the regular season and the league playoffs: a gain with 1st-place odds falling comes from the playoffs alone. 2027: room $-60 -> $-71, strength +44; 2028: room $124 -> $168, strength +36; 2029: room $179 -> $227, strength +34; picks given -107 points over their rookie deals.
decisions.change: His posture (a seller turning buyer), injuries, or a counter that moves value.
